evidence.quote: Fees and expenses would be paid separately, subject to court approval; any amount not awarded would go to the class.
We can keep your proposed fee terms unchanged if Brightline increases the class fund to $30 million.
Accepting secures a resolution at a lower cost than the other current offers.

summary: Plaintiff counsel first raised fees in the opening public proposal, and fees were negotiated as part of the settlement before the class relief was finally accepted. Hargrove expressly linked leaving the fee terms unchanged to an increased class fund. Defense accepted Hargrove’s lower-cost proposal compared with the other current offers, supporting a conservative finding of reverse-auction tactics, but the record does not show plaintiff counsel prioritizing its own fees over the class or a misleading declaration.
